body.name: Point-mass challenge-estimand collapse handle
body.construction: For \(K=2\), place the four point-mass controlled challenge risks entering \(\operatorname{CSE}^{\mathrm P}_t(x)\), including the period-two no-prior-exposure responses \(R^{[0]}_{2av}\), on the positive comparison face of the fixed sensitivity fiber \(\mathcal P_\delta(b,q,\omega)\). Use paired linear-fractional primal programs and Farkas certificates for the exposure-ratio and scaled-new-infection restrictions to determine whether the face is empty, whether \(\operatorname{CSE}^{\mathrm P}_t\) is nonconstant on a nonempty face, and whether a constant value on a nonempty face equals \(\operatorname{CSE}^{\mathrm{obs}}_t(b)\). Certify these three branches, respectively, by a separating infeasibility ray, two endpoint laws obtained through the common-history lift, or one compatible-law observable-mismatch witness whose controlled-risk value differs from the observed-hazard functional.
